t: #4004 Minimum Moves to Balance Circular Array II — From Edge Flows to a Median Formula
o: Each person with surplus must ship units along cycle edges (each hop between neighbors costs 1 move) until nobody is negative. In Example 1, person 1 sends one unit each way: 2 moves. In Example 2, person 0 ships once right and twice left (to person 2, which is one hop away on a 3-cycle): 3 moves. Example 3 shows impossibility: total balance is negative, so someone must stay negative. Constraints (n ≤ 1000) allow anything from O(n²) to O(n log n).
k: Any shipment decomposes into per-edge flows; the net flow on each cycle edge is all that matters.
Fixing the flow f on one edge determines every other flow by prefix sums, so the answer is min over one scalar of a sum of absolute values — solved by the median.
Impossible exactly when the total balance is negative.

a.i: Let f_i be the net flow from i to i+1 (negative = reverse). Conservation gives f_i = c + Q_i where Q_i is the prefix sum of balance[1..i] and c is a free circulation constant around the cycle. Total cost is Σ|Q_i + c|, piecewise linear in c, so testing each candidate c = −Q_i finds the minimum.
s: If the total balance is negative, return -1.
Build prefix sums Q of balance[1..n-1] with Q[0] = 0.
For each candidate c = -Q[i], compute Σ|Q_j + c| and take the minimum.
a.t: O(n²) — for each of n candidate circulation values we rescan all n prefix sums.

a.i: Σ|Q_i + c| is minimized when −c is the median of the Q_i: the median minimizes the sum of absolute deviations. So sort Q and sum distances to its middle element.
s: Return -1 if the total balance is negative.
Compute prefix sums Q of balance[1..n-1] (Q[0] = 0) and sort them.
a.t: O(n log n) — dominated by sorting the prefix sums.

w: Lead with the median approach; derive the flow-conservation relation on a whiteboard to justify it. Pitfalls: forgetting the wrap-around edge (n−1 → 0) — handled implicitly by the free circulation constant — and using prefix sums of balance[0..] instead of balance[1..] (off-by-one changes which edge carries the free constant). Watch 64-bit overflow: answers reach ~10¹¹. Follow-ups: report the actual transfer schedule, or handle a line instead of a cycle (then the constant is forced to 0 and the answer is Σ|prefix sums|).
